The '''Republic Institute Journal of Endocrinology''' was a journal. While [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]] was kept prisoner on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], she wanted a current copy of the journal after she gave [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] her datapad with the information on ways to slow the clones' aging process.
